title: Zephyr C: NV-persisted per-gateway claim_seq replay gate (slot_claim_settings)
description:
NV-persisted per-gateway claim_seq high-water for the slot-claim replay gate (parent design D4). Spec basis: GCP-6.5 step 8 + persistence table (spec/08-gateway-coordination.md:193,210-220) as amended by the spec child (receiver-side MUST persist).

Template: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/replay_settings.c:1-76 — SETTINGS_STATIC_HANDLER_DEFINE with root "lichen/replay", dual-blob a/b wear-leveling, K_MUTEX, load/save ops. Mirror that pattern under root "lichen/slot_claim", one entry per gateway IID (settings name = 16 hex chars of IID, value = uint32 LE high-water).

Implementation:
1. New module lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/slot_claim_settings.c (+ Kconfig CONFIG_LICHEN_SLOT_CLAIM_REPLAY, default y when slot coord is on): API slot_claim_seq_load(iid, &seq) / slot_claim_seq_store(iid, seq); RAM cache table of CONFIG_LICHEN_SLOT_COORD_MAX_GATEWAYS {iid[8], seq, valid} guarded by mutex; lazy settings_load_subtree("lichen/slot_claim") at coord init.
2. Wire into lichen_slot_coord_process_claim (coap_slot_coord.c:290-341) after signature verify and expiry check, BEFORE conflict resolution (:341-365): if claim_seq <= cached -> new enum LICHEN_CLAIM_REJECT_REPLAY (coap_slot_coord.h:83-93, value 5) -> 4.03 Forbidden at the resource (:1013-1024 mapping). On accept path, store new high-water BEFORE registering the gateway (:367-376) — persist-first: a burned seq only forces the legitimate sender to increment (spec :219); apply-then-persist reopens the replay window on crash-between.
3. New result enum value mapped in the POST handler response-code selection; do not silent-discard replay (it is a validation failure per spec :198, not a signature failure).
4. Wear consideration: claims are infrequent (superframe-scale); note expected write rate in the Kconfig help text; dual-blob pattern from replay_settings.c keeps erase wear bounded.
5. Host test: simulate store/load cycles + reboot (re-open) in the lichen/tests/ CMake harness with a settings backend stub; assert reject <= cached, accept > cached, persistence survives re-init.

Acceptance criteria:
- Claim with claim_seq equal to or below the persisted high-water for that IID is rejected with LICHEN_CLAIM_REJECT_REPLAY -> 4.03; higher seq accepted and persisted.
- High-water survives simulated reboot (RAM cache rebuilt from NV).
- First-ever claim from an IID (no cached entry) accepted per spec :193.
- Store happens before slot-table mutation (unit test asserts ordering via hooks or state inspection).
- Host CMake test passes ASan/UBSan; cppcheck clean.
close_reason: Decomposed per >50-line rule: child 1 = slot_claim_settings.c NV settings module (discovered-from nwjl.4), child 2 = wiring into lichen_slot_coord_process_claim + LICHEN_CLAIM_REJECT_REPLAY + 4.03 mapping + replay test. Full template/spec refs preserved in child descriptions. Picking up smaller beads per one-bead loop.
